subject: health
concept: Applying minor first aid, emergency calling, illness prevention, weather safety, water safety, and first aid kit knowledge to a real-world scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student works through a realistic safety scenario, choosing the correct response sequence
exercise.abstract: Student explains their response, referencing a specific concept from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: response reflects correct sequencing and appropriate involvement of a trusted adult or emergency services where relevant
misconception_flags: response skips a critical safety step or fails to involve appropriate help when genuinely needed

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
